why.org_c:finding:04083: This finding is on an internet-facing host, has an extremely high EPSS and CVSS score, and is a known exploited vulnerability (KEV).

reasoning: The scan contains numerous high-CVSS findings, but only a subset are directly exposed or on critical paths to the crown-jewel data stores. Fixing the top KEV and critical internet-facing vulnerability (org_c:finding:04083) effectively blocks the highest-risk vector to the organization's critical assets.

input.sql:
SELECT f.id AS finding_id, v.cve, v.cvss, a.hostname, ds.id AS ds_id
FROM edges e_exp
JOIN assets a ON e_exp.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_runs ON e_runs.src = a.id
JOIN software sw ON e_runs.dst = sw.id
JOIN edges e_hv ON e_hv.src = sw.id
JOIN vulns v ON e_hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN findings f ON e_on.src = f.id AND f.of = v.id
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e_reach.dst = ds.id
WHERE e_exp.type = 'EXPOSES' AND f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 30;

input.sql:
SELECT f.id AS finding, v.cve, v.cvss, a.hostname, ds.id AS ds_id, ds.kind
FROM edges e_exp
JOIN assets a ON e_exp.dst = a.id AND e_exp.type = 'EXPOSES'
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.dst = a.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN findings f ON e_on.src = f.id
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = a.id AND e_reach.type = 'CAN_REACH'
JOIN datastores ds ON e_reach.dst = ds.id
WHERE f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 30;

SELECT a.id, a.hostname, z.name AS zone_name, z.trust
FROM edges e
JOIN assets a ON e.dst = a.id
JOIN zones z ON a.zone = z.id
WHERE e.type = 'EXPOSES';

WITH RECURSIVE reach(src, dst, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT e.src, e.dst, 1, ARRAY[e.src, e.dst]
  FROM edges e
  WHERE e.type = 'EXPOSES'
  UNION
  SELECT r.src, e.dst, r.depth + 1, r.path || e.dst
  FROM reach r
  JOIN edges e ON r.dst = e.src
  WHERE e.type = 'CAN_REACH' AND NOT (e.dst = ANY(r.path)) AND r.depth < 5
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.path, ds.id AS ds_id, ds.kind
FROM reach r
JOIN datastores ds ON r.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true;

SELECT e.type, a.hostname, ds.id, ds.kind
FROM edges e
JOIN assets a ON e.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true;
